context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 65 verified AI Assistant premium feature. Key findings: (1) Backend endpoint POST /api/ai/assistant requires auth (401) and ambassador level (403 for sonhador). (2) Response structure: {response, suggestions, can_apply, apply_prompt}. (3) Frontend AIAssistant component renders inside TravelPlanner after plan generation, wrapped in PremiumGate with label 'Desbloqueia o assistente completo'. (4) 4 quick action buttons: Tornar mais barato, Experiencias unicas, Melhorar distribuicao dos dias, Ajustar ao clima. (5) Loading state shows 'A analisar o teu plano...'. (6) Text input appears after first interaction. (7) 'Aplicar ao roteiro' button appears when can_apply=true. (8) Fixed auth bug in server.py - was returning 500 instead of 401 for unauthenticated requests. Note: Full UI testing requires generating a travel plan first (takes ~30 seconds) then scrolling to find AI Assistant section.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug found and fixed: The /api/ai/assistant endpoint was returning 500 Internal Server Error instead of 401 Unauthorized when no authentication was provided. Root cause: get_current_user() returns None when no auth token is present (doesn't raise exception), but the code tried to access user.user_id without checking if user is None first. Fix: Added explicit 'if not user: raise HTTPException(status_code=401)' check after calling get_current_user().
